steps.meaning: Methodological demands (eg, dual screening, meta-analysis, certainty grading) consume resources and feed back to feasibility.
A severe feasibility shortfall can force the team to revisit its purpose.
Feasibility constraints reshape the objective (narrow, broaden, re-scope or defer).
The objective is made answerable as a research question.
The objective sets the breadth of the search (eg, new review or update; systematic or scoping).
The agreed purpose in turn shapes what each member seeks from the review.
The team's purpose directs attention to a particular clinical or scientific gap.
Through its framework and eligibility criteria, the question delimits the relevant region of the Literature Universe, bounding what the Review Universe can hold.
Executing the strategy and applying eligibility criteria move selected records into the Review Universe.
